resources.string: Enter where your server hosts the dashboard: its MagicDNS name on your tailnet, or its address through an edge, <server id>.<server domain>. On a tailnet, this phone has to be signed in to the same tailnet. Through an edge, the dashboard signs you in through your browser.

The app stores the server name and, after a sign-in through an edge, the dashboard\'s session cookie. It sends nothing anywhere but that server. Privacy policy: https://github.com/3xDevOps/Aether/blob/main/docs/privacy.md
Enter the server\'s tailnet name or edge address, for example my-server.tailnet-name.ts.net
The dashboard is served over HTTPS only. Enter the server\'s name, or an https:// address.
A server address carries no username or password.
No app on this phone opens %1$s
A sign-in link opened the app before a server was set, so it was not used. Enter the server\'s address, open the dashboard and sign in again.
Refused a sign-in link: the edge sends aether://auth/callback with a code and a state and nothing else.
Refused a sign-in link: its code or state is not in the form the edge issues.
Refused a sign-in link: it completes a sign-in through an edge, and the app is set to %1$s, which is not an edge address.
